title: A billable work order with every line No Charge invoices at $0.00
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Complete, billable, whose only two lines are both No Charge under Goodwill.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Create invoice.
  3. Open the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 shows no badge and offers "Create invoice", not "Close Work Order".

Step 2:

  • The invoice is created.

Step 3:

  • The invoice reads $0.00 with nothing owed, as a $0 invoice is today.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R10: “If every line of the work order is No Charge, the work order still invoices at $0.00 as a billable work order (one invoice, nothing owed, as a $0 invoice is paid today); the dialog of S12-R2 shows the hint "All lines are No Charge. To close without an invoice and get the NO CHARGE document, convert the work order instead." The whole-work-order path (Stories 2 and 3) is unchanged.”
